r01c-terrain-fixed_absolute-registered_d.semantics: Geometric Sun/Earth centers, DE421 / MOON_ME_DE421, aberration NONE
held: Same archived site, ephemeris and visibility observable
Same observer convention and episode selection policy
Same local replacement footprint and unchanged exterior terrain
r01c-terrain-fixed_absolute-registered_d.changed: Terrain representation, including spacing, processing and alignment; absolute observer elevation is held fixed
r01c-terrain-fixed_absolute-registered_d.qualification: A representation response is not absolute terrain truth or proof of convergence. Synthetic averaging remains separate from native NASA products.

r01b-dgr101-semantics.semantics: Center-visible versus any part of each spherical body visible
held: Same primary 0.1° / radial-factor-1 P78 horizon
Same site, observer, ephemeris, domain and 300 s event-search cadence
r01b-dgr101-semantics.changed: The visibility acceptance criterion: geometric center versus any-disc
r01b-dgr101-semantics.qualification: These are different physical observables. The 5.40-day center baseline is from the earlier primary grid and must not be relabeled as the refined 7.40-day complete R-01C case. Spherical caps omit Earth oblateness, phase and radiance weighting.
